svg.title: Urna Aberta: how a voter can check a ballot receipt
svg.desc: Educational animation in four scenes. 1: In Brazil today a voting machine produces a polling-station bulletin, the Boletim de Urna; the public can compare station totals but that bulletin is not an individual ballot receipt. 2: In Urna Aberta, a proposed voting system, an offline machine issues a receipt before the voter chooses CONFIRM or TEST; the receipt does not name the candidate. 3: TEST opens and voids that ballot and the elector votes again; CONFIRM leaves the ballot encrypted. 4: Signed batches go to a public board and an independent verifier checks receipt inclusion and the tally. Educational prototype, not production-ready.
